name: Matomo
line: Open-source analytics you can host yourself or buy as Cloud.

free.text: Free self-host: unlimited users/hits; Cloud 21-day trial

cells.location: Germany primary, Ireland backups; NZ support access

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews count as 10,000 hits. The 50,000-hit band costs INR 1,690 a month.
100,000 pageviews count as 100,000 hits. The 100,000-hit band costs INR 3,090 a month.
1,000,000 pageviews count as 1,000,000 hits. The 1m-hit band costs INR 13,900 a month.
